subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status show per-tool labels, and if so under which safe visibility/default or config gate?
rationale: Current main has three overlapping progress surfaces: generic native loading messages, optional status reactions, and preview progress. Choosing per-tool native status affects Slack UX, disclosure, and defaults, so automation should not pick the product policy alone.

options.title: Reconcile With Safe Visibility First
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the Slack-safe visibility/default policy, then implement only coarse approved labels through the existing tool lifecycle path.

options.title: Treat Generic Loading Messages As Enough
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers decide Slack native status should remain generic while detailed progress stays in previews/reactions.

options.title: Implement Direct Per-Tool Status
options.body: Allow a focused PR to update `assistant.threads.setStatus` on tool starts with safe labels and cleanup handling, accepting the additional Slack progress surface.

recommendation.title: Reconcile With Safe Visibility First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the Slack-safe visibility/default policy, then implement only coarse approved labels through the existing tool lifecycle path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Slack native status and loading-message work makes this the clearest available owner for the product/default decision.
